He misappropriated 300,000 yuan (30万元) from the funds, used with Jiang. This is embezzlement (挪用公款) i.e., "挪用公款罪" under Criminal Law article 382 (formerly 384). Also possibly "职务侵占罪" (misappropriation of public funds by a public official). Since he was a village accountant and cash custodian for a government project, the funds are public funds. The crime is "挪用公款罪". Also could be "受贿罪"? No, he didn't receive bribe. So single charge: 挪用公款罪.
